import zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
def local(tag): return tag.split('}')[-1]
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
for row in root.iter():
    if local(row.tag) != 'row': continue
    cells = []
    for c in row:
        ref = c.get('r'); t = c.get('t')
        parts = []
        for child in c:
            lt = local(child.tag)
            if lt == 'v':
                parts.append('v=' + (child.text or ''))
            elif lt == 'f':
                parts.append('f=' + (child.text or ''))
            elif lt == 'is':
                txt = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in child.iter() if local(x.tag) == 't')
                parts.append('is=' + repr(txt))
        cells.append(ref + '[' + t + '](' + ','.join(parts) + ')')
    print(' | '.join(cells))
"
